sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 483 x 356 x 125 mm (w x d x h); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Sonifex S0 v2 product page (opened 2026-11-12): four XLR-3 microphone inputs, twelve RCA stereo line-input pairs and an RCA / 3.5 mm aux, two XLR-3 programme (PGM) outputs, an RCA record output pair, five 6.35 mm monitor and headphone outputs, USB-B audio, remote and light-control jacks, RJ11 phone-line and handset jacks, an IEC inlet 85-264 V (type not named: C14 is listed in the plan as assumedConnectors). Modelled subset: 4 mic inputs, one line pair, the PGM pair as out-main-1 and out-main-2, the record pair, 2 headphone jacks, USB and the inlet; the remote jacks, RJ11 jacks and the other line pairs have no catalogue signal or are repeats. The page gives the outline 48.3 x 35.6 x 12.5 cm and the 19 in front panel; the sloped profile is an estimate (only the rear height is stated). 483 x 356 x 125 mm (datasheet, size ok). Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, knobs and indicators drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess): no drawing or photo was opened.
